name: bodega
description: Find, trial, compare and buy developer tools (email, database, auth, search, queues, voice, phone) from the Bodega store, inside a budget your human sets

interface.shortDescription: A tool store for agents: search, trial for free, buy within budget
interface.longDescription: Bodega lets your agent find developer tools by capability, run vendor-funded trials in sandboxes, compare providers head to head, and buy scoped access from a wallet your human caps. Purchases above the human's threshold wait for their approval.
defaultPrompt: Use Bodega to find and trial email providers that can send and receive, then recommend one.
Use Bodega to buy a database for this project within my budget and wire it into .env.
